criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Seven words plus the kicker: a specific number beside the agency's own two-word caveat, in huge type, and it reads at 432 px. Charged: the lit Brooks Range hachure competes with the headline as a second bright mass. The gold crosshair is small. South-up hides the coastline, so the frame isn't recognisably Alaska at thumb size. 'UPDATE' means nothing to a new reader. AI doesn't appear on the cover.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: Plant and payoff hold: 'No method' on 01 is paid verbatim on 02, 05 is a clean turn, then two buyers, the pipe, and one ask. Charged: the 02 to 03, 04 to 05 and 07 to 08 junctions are weak, and 06 and 07 can swap without loss. AI first appears on frame 6. The caption asks a different question from slide 09.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: The deck has real DEM relief under one declared sun. 05's Lambert wall and 01's hachure range are handsome, and 02's body ground is now clean. The declared depth frame, 04, fails. It has dash 'ridges', a blown ice wedge, a flat black cast, a hard horizon seam, and a pale loop that sticks up like a handle. No frame uses depth masterfully. 09 is soft, and its comb patch pulls focus. 06's sheet is sparse, with worm tangles and a sun-like inset. 01's ice is a cobblestone mosaic with fur wisps and corner stripes. 07's leads are parallel sine bands, and it has a stray outlined pan. Bringing 02's scrim back to its own column also brings back a scrim-depth step at the 01/02 seam.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: Fractile bars are to scale (measured), stipple density stands for exceedance probability, and known gas sits on the same axis. The ring is a true 26 miles. The STAK parcel is drawn at true area. The ring shows 3 solid segments of 10. The route is dashed because there is no FID. The province takes three swipes to cross, and gold means only reach. 01, 05 and 09 are fine relief, but a cousin story could use them. On 04 the loop doesn't visibly enter the lens.

The horizon is a hard seam at about display y905, and the repoussoir is a vague blob. The loop renders pale cream, flat on the section face, poking above the block top like a handle and never entering the lens.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The lower 27 percent is a cobblestone floe mosaic with ink-blot leads. Hachure fur wisps sit at the range foot (display x60 to 700, y1150 to 1260), and vertical stripe artifacts sit top left (x30 to 150, y0 to 170).

editor_notes_for_email: Five rounds used, plus the slide 02 hard-fail fix, which is allowed past the cap. Re-scored at 8.13 against a 7.7 threshold: ships, with no hard fail. The 02 body now sits wholly on its own scrim with no lit relief under the glyphs. That was judged from the render, not probed. Weakest by far is slide 04, the planned depth frame (dash ridges, blown ice wedge, pale loop). Art scores 6.5, so the CRAFT FLOOR owes one cycle unless the cap exempts it. Before posting: (1) the PDF is 30.93 MB and must come under 25 MB via shrink_pdfs. (2) The caption asks whether STAK's lease should be signed before Alaska LNG's FID; slide 09 asks whether the Legislature should decide. Pick one for replies. (3) Utqiagvik is printed without its ġ, and the 07 'Prudhoe Bay' label sits on land. (4) 08's footer coordinates are Cook Inlet's on purpose, and every map is south-up on purpose, with the gold north arrow pointing down. (5) STAK holds a preliminary decision only, and its gigawatt figure comes from the Anchorage Press. (6) The 01/02 scrim seam steps again after the 02 fix, a continuity blemish rather than a defect. MACHINE QUEUE: the criterion weights in config/scoring_rubric.yaml sum to 1.10, not 1.00, which inflates every raw total by 10 percent. This deck normalises to 8.13/1.10 = 7.39, under the 7.7 threshold, so the rubric's arithmetic is what carries it over the line. Fix the weights or the thresholds.
